patthana22.13:1.1: na kusalaṃ na niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo niyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi.
patthana22.13:2.1: na akusalaṃ na aniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na abyākataṃ na aniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nakusalattika naniyataduke kusalattika niyatadukaṃ
